pages.text: External network interfaces connect large storage networks from other mods to a Sky Logistics line. Only pages for installed mods are shown. All three use the node-style screen for line, mode, resources, upgrades, redstone, priority, and filters. Enable the resources you want to move after placing an interface.

pages.title: Sky ME Interface
pages.text: The $(item)Sky ME Interface$() exposes an AE2 network as a Sky endpoint for items and fluids. Optional add-ons enable FE, chemicals, mana, Source, or Warden Souls. On 1.21.1 it can also read Warden Souls stored in AppliedSoul cells.
Attach the interface to a valid side of the ME network, then select its Sky line and operating mode.

pages.title: Sky RS Interface
pages.text: The $(item)Sky RS Interface$() exposes items and fluids in a Refined Storage network. Item and fluid paths can be disabled independently. Connect it to the RS network, then configure it as an extract or insert endpoint on a Sky line.
The interface has no intermediate buffer. If a target refuses a transfer, the resource remains in its original network.

pages.title: Sky Dimension Interface
pages.text: The $(item)Sky Dimension Interface$() accesses items, fluids, and FE in a Beyond Dimensions network. With Mekanism or Ars Nouveau, it also accesses chemicals or Source. On Minecraft 1.21.1, Industrial Foregoing: Souls adds Warden Souls, using fluid faces, pipes, limits, and filters.
The Sky Dimension Interface connects a Beyond Dimensions storage network. It is not the same as a Dimension Upgrade for ordinary nodes.

Extracting items from an external network requires a whitelist containing at least one concrete item or it will not work. Tag and mod filters cannot replace it. Dimension Upgrades do not load chunks, so unloaded targets are skipped.
